torpor_metabolic_discount_status: 300 t trade assumption only: 1500 versus 2500 kcal/person/day. Requires measured physiology; reference hardware budget receives no automatic mass credit.

flight_occupancy.policy: 24 remain in torpor through departure, coast and arrival braking; all 32 are awake for descent. Surface food provision supports 32 awake.

design_to_margin_status: 15% planning case requested for comparison; legacy reference remains 25%. Lower allowance accepts more risk, not a physical hardware saving.
dry_mass_cap_status: Design-to allocation in mission-300-trade.json; not a validated achieved hardware mass or the existing viewer geometry.
food_factory_policy: Two independent complete-diet production trains, protected culture/enzyme banks and common waste recovery. Lowest studied 10 t hardware target, not a demonstrated minimum.
thermal_switch_status: Conditional continuous-braking target only. Direct exhaust down to 1 km is not radiation/plume qualified; 0.400 km/s includes 0.0757 km/s beyond ideal terminal thrust integral, not a demonstrated contingency margin.
surface_delivery_policy: Retain settlement essentials and mandatory descent equipment. Detach flight-only hardware in a controlled destination orbit before direct terminal descent; trajectory/disposal and staging qualification unresolved.
arrival_delta_v_allocation_status: 12 km/s total direct allowance split into 2 km/s before orbital separation and 10 km/s for independent descent. Conditional allocation, not a solved capture/entry trajectory.
